content.short: Analyzes gas usage for function calls to help optimize smart contracts.
content.description: Tenderly Gas Profiler analyzes gas usage on a per-function-call basis to improve accuracy and help developers optimize smart contracts. It supports building gas-efficient Solidity code across Ethereum, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Fantom, and Multichain, and includes an open-source CLI that makes tracing smart contract execution straightforward. By inspecting function-level gas patterns, teams can identify costly operations, refine logic, and reduce deployment and runtime costs across multiple networks. This profiler helps teams iterate faster and ship cost-efficient contracts across diverse networks.
